reviewer.note: Round 3 review at 8c212777 (PR #450), docs/reviews/2026-11-08-crossroads-placed.md, round 3. The warm lit glass still passes. The plinth is the same build as lantern_dark and fails for the same reasons (one-tone front region 104 texels here, single-row top planes, a one-column lit west face, four evenly spaced moss tufts in a row). Bar 0.57 -> 0.61. Rejected (unchanged from round 2): detail.light on the glass, the light source. Fix list: XR3-L1, XR3-L2.
fix_list: XR3-L1: give each slab its volume back while keeping the tooling: a distinct top plane 2-3 rows deep in tone 4 with a lit front-left arris, a 1-row bevel step, a lit west end face 2-3 columns wide, the front in 3 tones (no one-tone run over 60 texels), the east face in core shadow, two chips with lit lips
XR3-L2: moss as one or two ragged clumps of different size in the joint (a 2 px lit cap over a 3-4 px band with a ragged dark underside), placed unevenly, never four equal tufts in a row
